title: Token边界的代价：压缩证书与预测
summary: 研究量化了预分词边界对压缩成本的影响：在英文维基百科上，边界使最优token数增加28.3%-36.8%。压缩与预测偏好不同词典，无限制拟合在12种语言中均获得更低的每字节比特数。提出边界许可证机制，许可10%词表预算即可恢复大部分token数缩减。
summary_en: This paper quantifies the compression cost of pre-tokenisation boundaries, showing boundaries increase optimal token count by 28.3-36.8% on English Wikipedia. Compression and prediction favor different dictionaries; unrestricted fitting yields lower held-out bits per byte across 12 languages. Boundary licences are introduced, where licensing 10% of vocabulary budget recovers most token-count reduction.
